computed_interpretation: ERA5-Land and GPM nearly coincide near 53.5 mm, but the reported 104 mm box total and 271 mm Jalhay station total are about 1.94x and 5.06x larger, so the gridded maxima are a lower-scale consistency signal rather than a station-extreme proxy.

claim_limits: Do not treat the gridded maximum as the highest station 48-hour rainfall.
Do not treat null CHIRPS statistics as a finite rainfall estimate.
required_points: ERA5-Land and GPM event maxima are nearly identical near 53.5 mm.
The ECMWF 104 mm box total is about 1.94 times the larger gridded maximum.
The 271 mm Jalhay station total is about 5.06 times the larger gridded maximum.
The 20-25 percent fraction applied to 104 mm gives 20.8-26.0 mm.
CHIRPS event statistics are null, so they do not add finite event totals.
